shortDescription: FreeBSD control (start/stop/etc.) or list system services

options.name: command
options.description: rc.d script command. This option is required if O(script) is required and O(synopsis) is V(false) (default).

options.name: env
options.description: Set environment before starting the script. Available in FreeBSD 14.0 and later.

options.name: jail
options.description: Perform the given actions under the named jail. The O(jail) value can be either a jail ID or a jail name. Jail name doesn't work in C(iocage) jails. Use JID.

options.name: list_enabled
options.description: List enabled services and exit. This option ignores the C(check_mode)

options.name: script
options.description: rc.d script name. This option is required if O(list_enabled) is V(false) (default).

options.name: synopsis
options.description: Get script commands synopsis. Return attribute C(synopsis) and exit. O(script) is required. Other options are ignored. This option ignores the C(check_mode)

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for a command C(service <script> <command>) to complete. Then, get the status. The status before and after the command is compared and if they are different the module returns C(changed=true). The default is 500ms
